metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Captures an inversion problem in film form: eight people at a dinner party during a comet find other houses holding the same eight people, and try to tell the worlds apart with numbered photos, dice and glow sticks — markers that keep getting copied or lost.

metas.name: Enemy
metas.description: Captures two men who are observably identical. A Toronto history professor finds an actor who is his exact double — same face, scar and voice — and no measurement he can run separates them, so the film lets the ambiguity stay open.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description: Captures investigators failing, for real. South Korea's first serial murder case, 1986: local cops who beat confessions out of people, a Seoul detective who trusts evidence, and a country equipped for neither to work.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: Captures fame eating a person's grip on which self is hers. A pop idol turned actress, a stalker, and a fan site narrating her life in first person — the animated form is what makes the slippage work.

metas.name: Cure
metas.description: Captures emptiness spreading from person to person. A Tokyo detective investigates murders where each killer is different, calm, and cannot explain themselves — hypnotic and grey rather than jumpy.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: Captures religious paranoia eating a family from inside its own beliefs. Puritan settlers exiled to a forest's edge: a crop fails, a baby vanishes, and their theology gives them only one interpretation.

metas.name: Lake Mungo
metas.description: Captures grief in the form of a family documentary. Found footage, but the subject is not the ghost — it is parents and a brother in interviews, months after a drowning, still looking for anything.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: Captures a family where grief and resentment were already there before anything supernatural. A grandmother dies, a mother builds miniature scenes of her life, and a dinner-table argument is the scariest sequence.

metas.name: Le Samouraï
metas.description: Captures cool as ritual and solitude. A Paris hitman in a trench coat, a grey room, a bird in a cage, an alibi arranged like furniture — almost no psychology given, all behaviour.

metas.name: The Conversation
metas.description: Captures a man whose job is listening realising he has finally heard something. A surveillance expert replays one taped conversation until a line changes meaning, and his own privacy obsession turns on him.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: Captures obsession with a case that will not close. San Francisco, years of codes, files, basements and false certainties; the killer fades and the men who chased him are what's left damaged.

metas.name: Sicario
metas.description: Captures an idealist being used as a legal fig leaf. An FBI agent attached to a border operation she is not briefed on, a convoy into Juárez filmed like an occupying army, rules revealed only after she has broken them.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description: Captures class envy curdling into a mystery with no floor. In Seoul, a delivery kid, a girl who mimes eating a tangerine so well you see it, a rich man who burns abandoned greenhouses — and a disappearance the film will not solve.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description: Captures despair finding a political shape inside a small church. A minister keeping a diary in a historic church that is mostly a gift shop, and a young activist asking whether God can forgive us for what we've done to the world.

metas.name: Solaris
metas.description: Captures grief arriving in physical form, in orbit. A psychologist on a space station finds the crew haunted by visitors the planet below has made from their memories — including his dead wife, who knows she isn't her.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: Captures two children learning their mother's life was a war they knew nothing about. Montreal twins, a will, two sealed letters, and a journey into a fictionalised Lebanon their mother never described — it hits like a Greek tragedy.

metas.name: The Lives of Others
metas.description: Captures a surveillance officer changed by the lives he's assigned to transcribe. East Berlin, 1984: a Stasi captain bugs a playwright's flat, types his reports, and quietly begins to edit what the state gets to know.

metas.name: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
metas.description: Captures espionage as tired old men in bad rooms. A mole inside British intelligence, investigated through retirement-age sadness, Christmas parties and files — almost nothing explodes; the atmosphere is the action.

metas.name: The Third Man
metas.description: Captures friendship curdling in a ruined, divided city. Postwar Vienna: a pulp writer arrives to find his friend dead and getting saintlier the less sense the story makes — zither music, sewers, and the ferris wheel speech.

metas.name: Inside Man
metas.description: Captures a bank robbery as theatre with a purpose you have to wait for. Manhattan hostages dressed identically to the robbers, a detective and a fixer circling each other, and a heist whose real target isn't the money.

metas.name: Atlantics
metas.description: Captures young men who leave by sea returning in another form. Dakar construction workers, unpaid for months, take a boat toward Spain; the film stays with the women left behind, the sea at night, and a love story conducted through possession and fever.
